system.description: They can fly, either through innate powers or by using gear. Build from heroes successfully Attacked by Skeeterbots in Scene 1. (1 per DNA-sampled hero of matching archetype.)
system.tactics: Mimic the copied hero; choose two abilities from the listed options, or make one up that mimics something the hero is good at.

system.description: Choose two abilities: Death From Above: +1 to Attack actions while flying. | Take to the Air: +1 to Boost actions related to flying. | Evasive Maneuvers: Gain +1 to Defend actions while flying.
